name: ROLE_ADMIN
description: Administrator with full access to all system features and settings.

name: MANAGER
description: Manager with access to team management and reporting features.

name: OFFICER
description: Officer with access to their own tasks and limited system features.

name: HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT
description: Head of Department personnel with access to employee management and HR-related features.

name: BRANCH_MANAGER
description: Branch Manager personnel with access to branch management and reporting features.

name: BRANCH_OPERATIONS_MANAGER
description: Branch Operations Manager personnel with access to transaction processing and customer service features.

name: DIRECTOR
description: Director personnel with access to strategic decision-making and high-level management features.

name: SUPERVISOR
description: Supervisor personnel with access to advanced tasks and responsibilities within their department.
